**ACCEPT** (objectui seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`) — PR #4099.

The dispatch asked for the two named ratchets plus a sweep; the sweep is what earned the acceptance. Instead of fix-and-re-run (one drift revealed per lap, because the anchor test aborts at first mismatch), the dev replicated both anchor rules and judged all 21 anchored ranges across the four generator maps at once — surfacing a THIRD drift the issue never named (`scaffold-dependencies.ts` root vite anchor, masked by lucide-react sorting first). Fixing only the card's two would have turned shard 1 red again on the next lap; that second red lap was demonstrated (reverse-verified by restoring just the invisible drift) and avoided. Also de-fossilised `app-generator.test.ts:1082`'s hard-coded `^1.28.0` — a weaker copy of the anchor rule pointing the other way that scored the correct fix as a regression; it now reads the same `inRepoRangesOf` anchor, so the next dependabot wave breaks one rule, not two contradicting ones. Fix direction confirmed from the ratchet's own docs (templates follow the repo), not from the dispatch prompt. The wave's other bumps (shiki, maplibre-gl, react-hook-form, next) are declared by no generator — swept, clean.

Both shards green exactly where main is red (each was `1 failed | 288 passed` on main, now 289/289); all 20 checks on the PR completed green, Bump Policy arbitrated patch/patch. Flipping ready + auto-merge; when this lands, main heals and #4095 → #4084 queue behind it in that order.
